meaningKo: 하루의 일을 마치다; 밤에 자러 가다
exampleEn: I'm really tired, so I think I'll call it a night.
exampleKo: 나는 정말 피곤해서, 이제 하루를 마치고 자러 가야 할 것 같아.
gameExamples: After a long day at work, I decided to call it a night.
The party was fun, but I have to wake up early tomorrow, so I’ll call it a night.
We finished our project, and now it's time to call it a night.
